name: messmate
description: IIIT mess management: React (Vite) + Express/Node API + SQLite database

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
